Subject: Recap from today's discovery + suggested next step

Hi Samir,

Thanks again for carving out 30 minutes today — I appreciate the clear timeboxed run through of Orchard's inference needs. Short recap below so we're aligned and nothing falls between the chairs: 

- Primary use case: anonymized patient note generation for after-visit summaries (latency sensitive on web UI, some batch jobs).
- Current constraints: GDPR-compliant hosting, strict audit logs, and a preference for predictable cost within a pilot budget.
- Success criteria for pilot: <10% latency increase from baseline for the UI flows, quantifiable cost per 1K tokens under the pilot cap, and reproducible evals on our prompt suite.
- Potential blockers: procurement wants a simple SOW and SOC2 evidence; IT will require a short network runbook for Private/VPC options.

Attachments: I attached a short discovery recap (20261115-orchard-discovery-recap.pdf) and a very rough pilot SOW template (pilot-sow-draft.docx) to speed procurement review.

Suggested next step: a 30-minute technical sync to review the SOW + narrow success metrics so we can scope a 4-week pilot. If that sounds right, here are three times I have open next week (all PST):
- Tuesday 11/17 10:00–10:30
- Wednesday 11/18 15:00–15:30
- Thursday 11/19 08:30–09:00

If none of those work, feel free to send a slot on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/alex-martinez/30min. If this is no longer a priority, a one-line reply saying so is totally fine — I won't keep nudging.

Thanks,
